    Michaelis-Menten enzyme kinetics

    Source: R/bio-bioprocess.R
    bio_enzyme_kinetics.Rd

    Estimates the maximum rate vmax and the Michaelis constant km from initial rates measured at several substrate concentrations. The default fits \(v = V_{max} S / (K_m + S)\) by nonlinear least squares with stats::nls(), started from the Hanes-Woolf estimates. The classic linearisations (Lineweaver-Burk, Eadie-Hofstee and Hanes-Woolf) are available for teaching and comparison; their standard errors come from the delta method. Give enzyme_conc to also get the turnover number kcat and the specificity constant kcat / km.

    Usage

    bio_enzyme_kinetics(
  .data,
  substrate,
  rate,
  .by = NULL,
  method = c("nls", "lineweaver_burk", "eadie_hofstee", "hanes_woolf"),
  enzyme_conc = NULL,
  level = 0.95
)

    Arguments

    .data

    A data frame or tibble.

    substrate, rate

    <tidy-select> Substrate concentration and initial rate columns.

    .by

    <tidy-select> Optional columns defining separate enzymes or conditions.

    method

    One of "nls", "lineweaver_burk", "eadie_hofstee" or "hanes_woolf".

    enzyme_conc

    Optional total enzyme concentration, in the same amount units as vmax per unit time.

    level

    Confidence level.

    Value

    A <bio_assay> with one row per group: the .by columns, vmax, vmax_se, km, km_se, kcat and kcat_km (when enzyme_conc is given), sigma, nobs and method.

    References

    Michaelis, L. and Menten, M. L. (1913). Die Kinetik der Invertinwirkung. Biochemische Zeitschrift, 49, 333-369.

    Bates, D. M. and Watts, D. G. (1988). Nonlinear Regression Analysis and Its Applications. Wiley. doi:10.1002/9780470316757

    Examples

    bio_enzyme_kinetics(puromycin_kinetics, substrate, rate, .by = state)
#> # A bio_assay: enzyme_kinetics: 2 x 8
#>   state      vmax vmax_se     km   km_se sigma  nobs method
#>   <chr>     <dbl>   <dbl>  <dbl>   <dbl> <dbl> <int> <chr> 
#> 1 treated    213.    6.95 0.0641 0.00828 10.9     12 nls   
#> 2 untreated  160.    6.48 0.0477 0.00778  9.77    11 nls   

# Compare with the Lineweaver-Burk linearisation
bio_enzyme_kinetics(puromycin_kinetics, substrate, rate,
  .by = state,
  method = "lineweaver_burk"
)
#> # A bio_assay: enzyme_kinetics: 2 x 8
#>   state      vmax vmax_se     km   km_se sigma  nobs method         
#>   <chr>     <dbl>   <dbl>  <dbl>   <dbl> <dbl> <int> <chr>          
#> 1 treated    196.    27.0 0.0484 0.0117   13.9    12 lineweaver_burk
#> 2 untreated  143.    11.7 0.0308 0.00554  13.1    11 lineweaver_burk
